measureRecords.whatItDoes: Changes Winchester’s annual budget deadlines and voting process. The Town Manager’s proposed budget and the school board’s departmental estimate would be due March 22 instead of March 15. The Selectmen and school board would hold one or more joint public hearings instead of two hearings; all special meetings of either board that review the budget would include at least one public-comment session. Copies of the proposed budget would be available seven days before the first Annual Town Budget Meeting instead of fifteen, with an online summary and Town Clerk access. The meeting would move from the second Monday in May to the first Monday at 7 p.m.; the adopted text sets the first referendum for the second Saturday afterward, from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Voting would use machines unless the Selectmen approve paper ballots. After a failed referendum, the Selectmen would meet within three days to revise the budget, publish a summary and make copies available within twenty-four hours of approval, and hold the next referendum on the second Saturday after the failed vote; this would repeat until a budget passes. The official materials disagree on the continued Town Meeting after a failed vote: the adopted paragraph says the following Monday, while the voter guide says the second Monday. Both provide for moving that meeting to Tuesday if it falls on Memorial Day.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed changes to the budget deadlines, public hearings and referendum process.
